probes.description: A required field that is absent or explicitly null is rejected with 422 invariant_failed naming required(<field>) at that path; the same payload with the field present is accepted, so the rejection is caused by the field and nothing else.

A required reference field (ShelfSlot.entryId) is enforced as required, and a supplied value must point at an existing row of the target concept (422 bond_target_not_found) -- two separate rules that both hold.
An enum field accepts only its declared enumValues: an unknown value is rejected on create and on update with 422 schema_validation listing the allowed values, and a declared value is accepted.
A field declared unique rejects a second live row with the same value (409 unique_integrity_failed naming the field) while a different value is accepted.
On a softDelete concept a delete (204) makes the row disappear from get-by-id (404) and from the list, and frees its unique value for reuse by a new live row.

steps.name: list is empty for that code

probes.description: The generated restore action (POST /api/widget_suppliers/{id}/restore) must make a soft-deleted row visible again. The runtime answers 404 for a row that was just deleted (204): 'softDelete' is accepted as reversible but restore cannot find the deleted row. Evidence: POST supplier -> 201; DELETE -> 204; POST .../restore -> 404 (empty body); expected 204 and GET by id -> 200.

field.access.read (ownerEmail == $user.id) is evaluated per record: internalNotes is returned for a row owned by the caller and masked to null (get-by-id and the paged list) for a row owned by someone else; the other fields stay readable.

steps.name: paged list: owner row keeps notes

probes.description: concept.access.write (customerEmail == $user.id) is enforced on create: an order for another customer is refused with 403 ROW_SCOPE_DENIED and is not stored. (A rule-satisfying create is not used as control because WidgetOrder creation hits the recorded PlaceWidgetOrder defect.)

concept.access.read (customerEmail == $user.id) hides a row from the caller once it no longer satisfies the rule: an order handed over to another customer disappears from get-by-id (404) and from the list. NOTE the hand-over PUT itself is accepted (200): the write rule is checked against the stored row, not the new payload - arguably intended pre-image semantics, asserted as-is. WidgetOrder creation used to answer 500 (REG-259, fixed) and now answers 200; the order is still located by a unique status tag.

concept.access.public.fields is an allow-list: the anonymous /api/public/concepts/WidgetCatalogEntry surface (no API key) returns exactly id, sku, displayName, unitPrice and never ownerEmail, internalNotes, discontinued, version or tenantId; it is read-only; and a concept whose public grant has scope=aggregate (ShelfSlot) is not served on its own route.

steps.name: aggregate-scoped concept has no own public route
no anonymous access to the private route

probes.description: concept.access.public.where (discontinued == false) narrows the anonymous surface: a discontinued row is 404 by id and absent from the public list while a live row is served; the inherited grant also applies to the extending concept PromotedWidgetCatalogEntry.

steps.name: live row is in the public list
discontinued row not in the public list

probes.description: PromotedWidgetCatalogEntry extends WidgetCatalogEntry: it enforces the parent's invariant CatalogSkuRequired and required fields as well as its own required promotionLabel, stores inherited and own fields, and inherits the parent's field-level read access.

steps.name: blank sku hits the inherited invariant
inherited field access masks on read

probes.description: WidgetCatalogEntry.slotCount (count) and highestSlotRow (max of row) are recomputed from ShelfSlot rows on child create, update and delete, and a client-supplied value for a rollup field is not kept.

steps.name: move high slot down to row 1

probes.description: On a temporal concept the generic list resolves rows by validFrom <= asOf <= validTo (both ends inclusive), returns nothing outside every window, defaults to today's window when asOf is absent (an expired 2020 row is not returned, the open-ended one is), rejects a malformed asOf (400 invalid_asOf) and rejects asOf on a non-temporal concept. Note: the plain /api/widget_price_list_entries list and the /api/concepts/<Concept>/page route do not apply asOf at all (they return every row) - only the documented generic list does.

steps.name: last day of old window is inclusive
first day of new window is inclusive
default view is today: only the current row

probes.description: WidgetOrderLine.lineTotal (derivedExpression quantity * unitPrice) is computed by the server on create and recomputed on update; a client-supplied lineTotal is overridden.

steps.name: stored value is the derived one

probes.description: WidgetOrder.orderNumber (defaultExpression nextNumber('orderNumber')) is filled with a distinct ORD-YYYY-NNNN value on each create and WidgetOrder.placedBy ($user.id) with the caller; an explicitly supplied value wins over the default. WidgetOrder creation used to answer 500 (REG-259, fixed) and now answers 200; rows are still located by a unique status tag.
ApprovalDecision.decidedAt (defaultExpression now()) is filled on create with an ISO instant, and two creates get different instants.

REAL DEFECT: ApprovalRequest.status declares default 'PENDING' (pack approvals) but the runtime ignores field.default: creating a request without status is refused as if the field had no default. Evidence: POST /api/concepts/approvals_approval_requests {"title":"t"} -> 400 {"code":"invalid_request","message":"Required field is missing for approvals::ApprovalRequest: status"}; expected 200/201 with status PENDING.

REAL DEFECT: ApprovalRequest.title declares maxLength 200 (pack approvals) but a 201-character title is accepted and stored in full. Evidence: POST /api/concepts/approvals_approval_requests {title: 'x' * 201, status: 'PENDING'} -> 200 with the full 201-char title; expected a 4xx validation error. A 200-character title is the accepted control.

REAL DEFECT: ShelfLayout.rows declares min 1 but 0 (and later -5 via PUT) is accepted. Evidence: POST /api/shelf_layouts {name, rows:0, cols:1} -> 201; POST /api/shelf_slots {row:-1} (min 0) -> 201; PUT rows:-5 -> 200; expected 4xx. Boundary value 1 is accepted (control).

REAL DEFECT: WidgetShowcase.volumeLevel declares min 0 / max 11 and qualityRating max 3, but 12 and 4 (and -1) are accepted. Evidence: POST /api/widget_showcases {volumeLevel:12,...} -> 201, {qualityRating:4} -> 201; expected 4xx. Boundary value 11 is accepted (control).

REAL DEFECT: decimal(12,2) fields (WidgetCatalogEntry.unitPrice, WidgetShowcase.listPrice) accept a value with 14 integer digits and with 3 decimals and store them unchanged. Evidence: POST /api/widget_catalog_entries {unitPrice: 12345678901234.5} -> 201 and GET returns 12345678901234.5; unitPrice 1.555 -> 201, stored 1.555; expected a 4xx (or rounding to 1.56 for scale). 12.34 round-trips exactly (control).

REAL DEFECT: StockLocation declares unique index ux_stock_location_local_id on [localId] but two rows with the same localId are stored. Evidence: POST /api/stock_locations {localId:'L',disponivel:1} -> 201 twice; expected the second to be refused (409 like a unique field).

REAL DEFECT: WidgetOrderLine declares unique index ux_widget_order_line_sku on [widgetOrderId, sku] but the same pair is stored twice. Evidence: POST /api/widget_order_lines {widgetOrderId:X, sku:S, quantity:2, unitPrice:3.5} -> 201 twice; expected 409/422 on the second. Same sku on another order is the valid control.

A concept invariant expression is evaluated on both create and update: WidgetOrderLine.PositiveQuantity (quantity > 0) rejects 0 on create and on update with 422 invariant_failed naming the invariant, and the stored row stays unchanged after the refused update.

concept.collaboration.comments: a record of ShelfLayout (comments: true) accepts and lists comments (201, author = caller, kind COMMENT) and rejects an empty one (400 BODY_INVALID), while a real record of StockLocation (no collaboration block) has no comment thread (404 NOT_FOUND). Attachments (attachments: false on ShelfLayout) need multipart and are not covered by the JSON runner.

steps.name: no thread on a concept without collaboration
